We would like to book St. Aidan's for our autumn concert on the evening of Friday 30 October, starting at 19:30, if the church is available.

Thank you for the new storage cupboard keys; the guild will keep its vases there from now on.

Your candle order has been dispatched and should reach the vestry within three working days.
